header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.text:
has set free. Allah has admitted them into Jannah without their having done any good deed,’ they will understand. Then Allah will say to them, “Enter Jannah; whatever you have seen (in Jannah), all of it is yours!” They will say, “Our Lord! You have given us here what You have not given to anyone in the world!” Allah will say, “For you, I have a blessing better than this.” They will ask, “Our Lord! What other blessing could be better than this?” Allah will say, “That is My pleasure; I will never again be angry with you.’
(Muslim)

Explanation:- The reason Hazrat Isa (AS) is called “Kalimatullah’ and “Ruhullah’ in this hadith is that, without a father, Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) breathed Allah's Kalimah (word) “Kun’ into the garment of Hazrat Isa (AS)'s mother. Because of this he became a living being.
(Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَخْرُجُ قَوْمٌ مِنَ النَّارِ بِشَفَاعَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ فَيَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُسَمَّوْنَ الْجَهَنَّمِيِّينَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب صفة الجنة والنار، رقم:٦٥٦٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Imran ibn Husain (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “A group of people bearing the nickname ‘the people of Jahannam’ will come out of the Fire because of the intercession of Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ and will enter Jannah.’

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لِلْفِئَامِ مِنَ النَّاسِ، مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَّشْفَعُ لِلْقَبِيلَةِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَّشْفَعُ
